description:
intent=i035 snapshot=s04 branch=caller-pointer-across-helper status=complete
finding location=net/mac80211/rx.c:3324-3336 confidence=medium conclusion=ieee80211_rx_h_data saves tf=rx->skb->data at rx.c:3324, pskb_may_pull at 3326-3327 can free/move the head on a non-linear TDLS RX frame, and the stale tf->payload_type/category/action_code reads at 3328-3331 give a remote slab-UAF read (medium confidence).
unresolved location=net/mac80211/rx.c:2985 conclusion=Follow up: read net/mac80211/rx.c around 2960-3040 to determine whether a mesh_hdr or ethhdr pointer cached before the pskb_may_pull calls at 2979/2985 is dereferenced afterwards without re-derivation on non-linear mesh frames.
unresolved location=net/openvswitch/flow.c:457 conclusion=Follow up: read net/openvswitch/flow.c parse_vlan (~450-480) to check whether the vlan header pointer is re-derived after pskb_may_pull and whether OVS-classified skbs can be non-linear at that point.
unresolved location=net/ipv6/ip6_gre.c:513 conclusion=Follow up: read net/ipv6/ip6_gre.c ~505-560 (and the ip_gre.c ERSPAN analogue) to check whether ershdr is re-derived after pskb_may_pull and used afterwards.
unresolved location=net/nfc/hci/core.c:912 conclusion=Follow up: read net/nfc/hci/core.c ~905-930 to check whether pointers into hcp_skb->data are re-derived after pskb_may_pull and whether NFC HCI link skbs can be non-linear.
coverage_gap=Per-protocol skb control-block structs (*_skb_cb with pointer- or offset-typed fields, e.g. DN_CB/IPCB analogues) were not systematically enumerated in s04, and the branch's DECnet template is absent entirely (net/decnet/ does not exist in this snapshot).
coverage_gap=No runtime KASAN build, reproducer, or per-driver audit was performed to prove that any WiFi driver actually delivers a frag-backed (non-linear) skb into ieee80211_rx_h_data on the s04 tree.
coverage_gap=Same-function save/pull/use sites already reported for s04 under other intents (net/802/garp.c:447-504, drivers/net/ppp/ppp_generic.c:3111-3172) were not re-audited for the cross-helper shape here.
limitation=The single finding is a source-reading hypothesis, not an observed crash: triggering requires a non-linear skb at ieee80211_rx_h_data so pskb_may_pull->__pskb_pull_tail actually reallocates and frees the old head; on linear-driver RX the pull is a no-op and tf remains valid.
limitation=Unlike the seed, the pull length is the compile-time constant offsetof(struct ieee80211_tdls_data, u), so no attacker-chosen pull length exists; only the stale-pointer-into-skb-head mechanism and the post-helper dereference match the branch invariant.
limitation=The stale tf reads occur inside the same boolean expression as the pull; the vulnerability judgment rests on C evaluation order (pskb_may_pull evaluated first) and on the compiler having to reload through tf since pskb_may_pull may alias the skb head, not on inspected generated code.
limitation=The reported lines were verified by direct reads (net/mac80211/rx.c:3282-3337), but the four unresolved candidates were triaged from this snapshot's prior fact cards and grep line numbers only and were not line-read in this session.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history, no network); line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s04 as supplied, and net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (lines 55-65) exhibits the identical seed pattern but was excluded from reporting by assignment rule.
